identity.name: Blockchain Venture Capital Inc. RWA Token

about.description: BVCIRWA is a security token providing tokenized access to Blockchain Venture Capital Inc. (CSE: BVCI), described as Canada's first regulated stablecoin issuer. Token price $1.00 per BVCIRWA (set by issuer). Deployed on Arbitrum via Stobox STV3 Protocol. ZGrowth uses a dual-token architecture: BVCIRWA (security token on Arbitrum) paired with uBVCIRWA (utility token tradable on Uniswap and Raydium DEX). Offering available to non-Canadian accredited and institutional investors subject to KYC/AML. SPV structure domiciled in BVI.
